description: ADO-CURSOR requested versus effective tuple on a read/write Connection, SELECT ID, S FROM T: twelve Recordset requests (location, CursorType, LockType): server keyset with each of the four lock types, client static with each of the four, server static batch, client keyset optimistic, client dynamic optimistic and client forward-only optimistic. For each read State, effective CursorType, LockType, CursorLocation, RecordCount, Supports of adUpdate, adAddNew, adDelete and adUpdateBatch, then the Errors (cleared) and Close. Asks the effective tuple and edit capabilities for each lock type and location.
